initialFindings.initial: Opening before type validation could block on a FIFO; unbounded readFile allocated before the final size check.
initialFindings.resolution: Pre-open lstat refuses non-regular files; O_NONBLOCK and O_NOFOLLOW defend the open race; fstat rechecks the opened object and 5 MiB cap; allocation and reads are bounded to stat.size + 1, and length changes reject before test execution.
initialFindings.verification: Source inspected; added symlink and FIFO refusal fixtures pass on both reviewed runtimes. No claim of detecting every same-length concurrent rewrite.

initialFindings.initial: RegExp coercion allowed a one-element SHA array to pass revision identity validation.
initialFindings.resolution: Explicit typeof sourceRevision === string guard precedes the SHA expression.
initialFindings.verification: One-element array regression fixture rejects before sentinel execution on both runtimes.

initialFindings.initial: Actual import/cwd execution was explicitly tested only in untimed mode.
initialFindings.resolution: The selected-source import, cwd and marker fixture now also runs with --timings.
initialFindings.verification: Timed and untimed import/cwd checks pass on both runtimes.

retainedInvariants: Test inventory comes only from the five selected-root discovery directories, never from telemetry.

Untimed round-robin assignment and child execution using selected-root cwd/import resolution remain unchanged.

outcome: No remaining concrete correctness blocker found in the two reviewed files after fixes.

shipping.reason: Both scripts lie outside explicit game/build-config.json include paths; collectBuildFiles uses that include list. Future git-archived source.tar includes committed script changes, but existing immutable release assets are not rewritten.

limits: Review covers the two exact file hashes only; reporter and measurement files from another agent are excluded.
No production workflow opt-in, remote CI trigger, full-suite qualification, browser journey or hosted speed measurement was performed.
The bounded file reader detects observed length change, not a cryptographic immutable snapshot; future workflow adoption must distribute one pinned timing manifest consistently across shards.

Timing source/node metadata is syntactically validated provenance of an advisory profile, not permission to reuse passing tests or a requirement that the selected current source equal the historical timing source.
Only this review receipt was authored; no source edits, commits, pushes or release actions were performed.
